MARIAN FINGLER On Wednesday, January 7, 2015 Marian Lorraine Fingler (nee Gatzke) passed away at the age of 84 years at Health Sciences Centre. Marian was born in Weyburn, SK on September 27, 1930, and her family moved to Winnipeg in 1945. She met her love, Gordon, at the age of 16 and they were married in 1951. They were blessed with their three children, Barry, Derek and Karen. As a young woman Marian worked as a hairdresser. Later she was employed at Acklands Ltd. for many years, followed by Texaco Canada, and lastly at Imperial Oil Company. She retired from Imperial Oil in 1992. She took great satisfaction in her work accomplishments, in addition to her pride in being a wonderful wife and mother. Marian was predeceased by her son Barry and husband Gordon in 1995 and 1996 respectively. She was also predeceased by her mother Wanda, father Edward, her brothers Ervin and Walter, and mother-in-law Katherine Fingler. She leaves to mourn her passing her son Derek (Leslie), daughter Karen (Ward Karlberg); her granddaughters Robyn (Graham) and Jane (Micah); her grandson Daniel (Callie), and her great-grandson Oliver. Also left to mourn are her sister Clara Baker, her brother Randolph (Diane), sister-in-law Lorna Zelmer, and additional family members and friends. Marian was devoted to her family. They meant everything to her, and she was always her happiest in their company. Her understanding nature, sense of humour and unwavering love and support were always appreciated. Marian was deeply loved and cherished by her family. Marian's family would like to extend their sincerest gratitude to home care, and to family and friends for the support, kindness and prayers received. Cremation has taken place. In keeping with Marian's wishes no formal service will be held. A private family interment will be held at a later date.

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Jan 10, 2015
